statements: CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.agent_registry (agent_id text PRIMARY KEY, agent_type text NOT NULL, capabilities jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, workspace text, trust_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', last_seen timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.personal_memories (memory_id text PRIMARY KEY, memory_type text NOT NULL, content text NOT NULL, confidence real NOT NULL, importance real NOT NULL, source text NOT NULL, agent_id text, project_id text, content_hash text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', last_confirmed timestamptz, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
